description:
FILED s479 (Fable, 2026-09-08) from the s473h merge-review probes.  PRE-EXISTING: identical on main a9f2a264 and on the s473h tree c8e8a848.

PROBE (perl 5.40.3 vs ./runpcl, `no strict`):
    my @l = (Qux); print "[@l]\n";       perl: [Qux]      PCL: Undefined subroutine &main::Qux called (the whole program dies)
    my $h = { Zed => 1 }; keys %$h       both: Zed        (the fat-comma autoquote is a different site and is right)

WHERE THE RULE LIVES: #266`s three-valued classifier (`_bareword_callable_here` -- yes / not-yet / no) decides a bare NAME is a CALL only where it is CALLABLE; s473h member 7 applied it at the STATEMENT site (`Foo;` -> the string constant; `p-bareword-value` asks the image for the `no` arm).  The LIST site (a bareword as a list element / call argument, parenthesised) still emits the call unconditionally.  Sibling tasks: #406 (a bareword ARGUMENT to a paren-less user sub call), #495 (a bareword operand of a prototyped sub), #476 (`-NAME`).  Grep for the sibling copy before touching the classifier (s473h found the emitter`s own builtin table had to be consulted, or `study;`/`reset;` stringify).

FIX SHAPE: the same three-valued answer at the list-element site -- `yes` keeps the call, `not-yet` the string, `no` asks the image the way member 7 does; under `use strict` perl dies "Bareword not allowed" (PCL: match if cheap, else the string + a not-supported note -- error-text fidelity is not a goal).  Guard rows in Pl/t/bareword-call-01.t beside member 7`s (a list, a call argument, a hash-subscript bareword `$h{Qux}` which must stay the autoquoted key, a bareword before its `sub` in the same file), inverse-verified.  Emission change -> gen bump + corpus-diff + emission-ab.  SIZE: S-M.
subject: An undeclared BAREWORD inside a parenthesised LIST (`my @l = (Qux);`, `f(Qux)`) is emitted as a CALL and dies "Undefined subroutine &main::Qux" where perl (no strict) yields the string "Qux" -- the list site of #266`s three-valued rule, beside s473h`s statement site
